fields.title: Output size type
fields.description: Defines how the size of the output is specified: as a percentage of total rows (relative) or as an absolute number of rows.

fields.title: Relative size
fields.description: Specifies the percentage of rows from the input table to be included in the output. Must be between 0 and 100 (inclusive).

fields.title: Number of rows
fields.description: Specifies the absolute number of rows to include in the output. If the input table contains fewer rows than specified, all rows are placed in the output.

fields.title: Sampling strategy
fields.description: Determines how rows are selected for the output. Strategies include random, stratified, linear, and first rows (sequential).

fields.title: Group column
fields.description: Specifies the column whose value distribution should be preserved in stratified sampling. Ensures both selected and non-selected rows reflect the same distribution of values.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Fixed random seed
fields.description: Optional seed value for random or stratified sampling. Using a seed ensures the same rows are selected each time the node is executed. Without a seed, a different random selection will occur each time.

fields.title: If input table is empty
fields.description: Defines how the node should behave when the input table has no rows. Options include generating empty outputs or failing the execution.
